name: surface-runtime-view-sidecar-queue
description: A window send to a sidecar is outstanding while a view sends two sidecar messages with their source authority; the view messages reach the host after the window send is answered, in the order of their generations, each with the authority it was sent with.
reason: sidecarSend and viewSidecarSend deliver bodies to a running sidecar process, which the producer does not start.
